candidates.evidence: CIOMS Guideline 11 carries a second re-consent trigger this candidate does not state. Alongside the scope-based trigger (re-consent when a use falls outside the authorized scope), it holds that informed opt-out procedures are inappropriate "when controversial or high-impact techniques are used" or "when research is conducted in contexts of heightened vulnerability", requiring explicit consent instead. That is a sensitivity-based trigger, and sensitivity is the axis fw2 divides on.
